title: Generator-normalized coefficientwise pullback of symmetric graded algebras
statement:
Let $g:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a quasi-coherent
$\mathcal O_S$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and suppose $g^*E$ is quasi-coherent, with
actual tensor pullback and its section $1\otimes m$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. For the
canonical symmetric graded algebras $A_S(E)$ and $A_X(g^*E)$
[def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra], there exists coefficientwise pullback
data $b$ along $g$ [def-nagata-graded-algebra-pullback-data]. For every affine
$U\subseteq S$, affine $W\subseteq X$ with $W\subseteq g^{-1}U$, its graded ring map
sends $\iota(m)$ to $\iota((1\otimes m)|_W)$ for every $m\in E(U)$. All base morphisms,
zero modules and empty schemes are included.

proof.text: send a scalar by the scheme structure map and send iota(m) to the inclusion of the restricted section 1 tensor m. The symmetric universal property constructs this ring map. Products of n degree-one generators show that it preserves degree n. Affine pullback sections identify the target module with scalar extension of the source module. Symmetric algebra base change therefore makes the corresponding scalar extension map bijective. Its grading and the direct-sum decomposition give bijectivity in each degree. Naturality of the pullback unit and restriction gives compatibility on affine refinements in both variables. These identities hold on scalars and on degree-one generators and extend by symmetric-algebra induction. This argument applies to every base morphism and includes zero rings and modules.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normalized_pullbackData {X S : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ S)
    (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    [((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E).IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ b : Scheme.GradedAlgebraData.PullbackData g (gradedAlgebraData E)
        (gradedAlgebraData ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E)),
      ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
        (m : E.val.obj (op U.1)),
        b.map h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(S, U.1) _ m) =
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(X, W.1) _
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackSection g E U.1 m))
